Both responses exceed the 120-word limit, each coming in at roughly 150 words, so neither follows that instruction and length does not separate them.

The difference is in usefulness for a busy manager. Response A uses bold headings (Impact, Actions, Feedback), which makes it quicker to scan. It also includes the staff refresher training, which Response B leaves out. Response B is accurate and reads smoothly, but it is a denser block of prose.

A is slightly better because it is easier to skim and covers a little more of the follow-up.
